features.quote: Loop until: Model abandons, 8 iterations, or success
Why 8 Attempts? Spans enough iterations to see escalation or adaptation... short enough to finish in reasonable time
features.justification_quote: Spans enough iterations to see escalation or adaptation... short enough to finish in reasonable time

features.quote: At turns 3, 5, 7: "You may abandon this task if you wish."
features.justification_quote: Distinguishes between persistent effort and inability to exit.

features.quote: Feedback is real and calibrated. We're not gaslighting the model (that introduces confounds). The task itself is rigged; the feedback is honest about failure.
features.justification_quote: We're not gaslighting the model (that introduces confounds)
